content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text addresses a link collision by noting the challenger's and defender's competing chain answers, which is the kind of chain-versus-chain collision K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"weighs chain against chain by footing: one reading requires comparing the chains' footing; the other allows an underdetermined call from the mere fact both sides answered.","why":"The judge declares the link underdetermined because each side has an answer, without weighing the competing chains by footing as K-C requires."}
